name: lemma_pod_tables
description:
List the pod's tables with their column schemas, or describe one table.

Omit ``table_name`` to list every table (each with columns, types, PK, RLS
flag). Pass ``table_name`` to describe just that one.

table_name.description: Omit to list all tables with their column schemas; pass a name to describe just that table.

name: lemma_pod_get_records
description:
Read records from a pod table.

Pass ``record_id`` to fetch a single record; omit it to list records with
optional ``filters`` and ``sorts``.

record_id.description: Fetch a single record by id; omit to list with filters/sorts.

op.description: eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, like, ilike, in. Use `in` with a list value for multi-value membership.

name: lemma_pod_write_record
description:
Create, update, or delete a record in a pod table (requires record.write grant).

- ``action="create"`` — needs ``data`` (column -> value).
- ``action="update"`` — needs ``record_id`` and ``data``.
- ``action="delete"`` — needs ``record_id``.

action.description: 'create' a new record, 'update' an existing one, or 'delete' one.

record_id.description: Target record id. Required for 'update' and 'delete'.

data.description: Column -> value mapping, e.g. {"title": "Q3 report", "amount": 42}, or a JSON-encoded string of it. Required and non-empty for 'create' and 'update'.

name: lemma_pod_query
description:
Run a read-only SQL query against the pod.

Reads across tables (joins, aggregates, subqueries) including RLS-enabled
tables; rows of an RLS table are always scoped to the agent's user (the same
per-user view its other record reads get). Only a single read-only SELECT is
allowed.

sql.description: A single read-only SELECT over the pod's tables. Joins/aggregates across tables are allowed, including RLS tables (rows scoped to you unless you administer the table). Mutations are rejected.

name: lemma_pod_list_files
description:
List pod files under a path.

``recursive=false`` (default) lists the immediate files and folders in
``path``. ``recursive=true`` returns a file tree rooted at ``path`` (folders
plus a sample of files per directory). Without an absolute path, resolves
against your default pod working directory (`/me/c/{date}/{slug}`).

path.description: Folder path, e.g. `/me` or a shared folder like `/knowledge`. A relative path resolves against `/me/c/{date}/{slug}`.

recursive.description: True returns a tree rooted at `path` instead of its children.

files_per_directory.description: Sample files per directory when recursive.

name: lemma_pod_read_file
description:
Read a pod file's text.

A file that has text of its own -- markdown, plain text, HTML, CSV, code,
email -- is returned exactly as it is. A file that has none, because it is a
binary document like a PDF or a DOCX, is returned as the markdown it was
converted into at upload.

Use ``pod_view_document_pages`` to *see* pages rather than read them.

path.description: Pod file path. Absolute paths (e.g. `/knowledge/notes.txt`) are used as-is; a relative path resolves against `/me/c/{date}/{slug}`.

page_start.description: Documents only: first page (1-based). Ignored for text files.

page_end.description: Documents only: last page, inclusive. Defaults to page_start.

name: lemma_pod_write_file
description:
Write text content to a pod file, creating or overwriting it.

Without an absolute path, the file lands in your default pod working
directory (`/me/c/{date}/{slug}`) — a stable, private location scoped to
this conversation. Writes under your own `/me/...` (including that default
location) never need approval; writes to a shared pod path may.

path.description: Pod file path. A relative path resolves against `/me/c/{date}/{slug}` — write there unless a specific shared location is needed.

overwrite.description: If false, reject the write when the file exists.

name: lemma_pod_view_document_pages
description:
Render PDF pages as images so you can *see* them (layout, tables, figures).

Pages are 1-based. Only PDFs can be rendered visually; for other document
types use ``pod_read_file`` to read the page text.

Set ``instructions`` to say what you need from the pages. If this agent's
model reads images itself you get the page images inline; otherwise a vision
model reads them and returns a description, so this tool works either way.

path.description: Path of a PDF document in the pod.

page_start.description: First page (1-based) to render as an image.

page_end.description: Last page (1-based, inclusive). Defaults to page_start.

instructions.description: What you need from these pages — 'transcribe the pricing table', 'describe the architecture diagram and its arrows'. Always set it: if this agent's model cannot read images itself, this is the question a vision model answers on your behalf.

name: lemma_pod_get_file_url
description:
Get a URL for a pod file, to share a link or embed an image.

``app`` (default) returns an in-app link for a signed-in member plus a
short-lived download url. ``public`` mints a signed link anyone can open —
it expires and dies after ``max_hits`` downloads.

url_type.description: 'app' = in-app link for a signed-in pod member. 'public' = hit-capped signed link anyone can open — use to send a file outside the pod.

max_hits.description: 'public' only: downloads before the link dies (default 200).

name: lemma_pod_search_files
description: Semantic/keyword search across indexed pod files.

scope_path.description: Restrict search to this folder subtree.
